manualOverrideReason: E2E OMD-1638 manual business hectares validation
notes: Uses existing Blackburn PIN 5255 Property/Orchard/Blocks. In --stage run, creates or verifies two test-owned MAs through KineX frontend before applying a manual hectare value and splitting the first mapped Block. Pin sourceBlockCode from inventory. Second MA Block defaults to the first distinct unassigned Block; configure blockCode to control it. Multiple Grower Supply options require maSetup.growerSupplyEntityId. Truck access defaults to first available test reference; configure maSetup.truckAccessId to pin it.
